name: auto-chain
description: Milestone → wave → task autonomous execution for large multi-session work. Opus plans, GPT-6.1 Sol reviews (OpenCode review-sol or codex CLI via a common review runner), Claude workers implement in parallel, and a lean coordinator session per milestone integrates, verifies and hands off to the next milestone. Execution backend is auto-selected: inside herdr, workers run as Claude sessions in side panes (model chosen per pane, live two-way messaging); inside Orca, the 1.7.1 Orca-tab flow. Per-project hooks via .claude/autonomous-chain.md.
